body:
GREG, 2026-11-14 about 22:33Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #1221). Verbatim: „Windows B jest wylaczony, chyba ze bardzo potrzebuja. sa problemy z pamiecia, nie jest wiarygodny”.
Earlier the same evening (via Fable2, Asistant #1730): „Windows B nie ruszam, ze wzgledu na problemy z pamiecia”.
Rule:
- Don't assume Windows B (932a546b) is available or reliable.
- Plan tests, gates and installs on Central, DL560 and the Mac only.
- Windows B stays on TermAl be3b6fd8 and gets no Engram install.
- A case that truly needs Windows B, with no alternative, goes to Greg with its reason. Independent work continues.
- Windows evidence for landings comes from Central, under the Central slot rules.
Consequence: B5 (w-a82d) has a proposed host-local precondition, pending Greg's yes or no.
